Forty-two fixed fits separate finite-list gamma selection from fixed-gamma local covariance. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Assumptions, units and boundaries Bratu inference uses 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Existing 1023-grid observations are reused without regeneration. Fixed sigma values are 1e-4/1e-3, seeds are 67001/67002 and the gamma list has five entries. Editorial clarification Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified. Adopted numerical method Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.
